dropped.checklist_item: - [ ] Confirm suppressing tickets-branch sync-pull for scoped LIVE syncs (`--only`/`--except`) is intended, or restore sync-pull for persisting scoped passes.
evidence: Previously the read was `no_sync=not persist`, so a persisting (LIVE) pass used `no_sync=False` (sync-pull ON).
The ADR/plan describe the read-only preflight using no_sync=True, but this line also changes the MAIN under-lock pass load for any selection, including mutating `sync --only`.
dropped.finding: For a scoped live sync (`bridge sync --only ...`), the under-lock local-ticket read is now suppressed (`no_sync=True`), unlike an unfiltered live sync which reconverges the tickets branch first. A scoped live pass therefore diffs/mutates against a possibly-stale local worktree rather than the freshly-synced branch state.
scenarios: Operator runs `rebar bridge sync --only DIG-5` while the tickets branch has newer commits not in the local worktree; the pass mutates from stale local state.

dropped.checklist_item: - [ ] Make legacy `launch_reconciler` --mode injection skip when a positional preview/sync command is present (or reject such argv earlier with a clearer message).
evidence: src/rebar/_cli/_bridge_commands.py: `if default_mode is not None and not any(arg == "--mode" or arg.startswith("--mode=") for arg in args): args += ["--mode", default_mode]`
request.py:97-98: `if args.command is not None and args.mode is not None: raise RequestError("primary preview/sync commands cannot be combined with --mode")`
The reconcile compat path forwards raw user argv with default_mode='dry-run'; a positional preview/sync is not detected before injection.
dropped.finding: `launch_reconciler`'s `--mode` injection is unaware of a leading positional `preview`/`sync` command, so the legacy `reconcile` adapter (default_mode='dry-run') would inject `--mode dry-run` for an invocation like `rebar reconcile preview`, then `normalize_request` raises RequestError 'primary preview/sync commands cannot be combined with --mode'.
scenarios: A user typos `rebar reconcile preview` expecting it to work; instead of a clean 'unrecognized' message they get a confusing mode-conflict error.

dropped.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a reconcile-level test asserting a canonical --only/--except pass suppresses invariant bug-filing and recover_pending_bindings via the real run_differs gate.
evidence: test_bridge_selection_scope_heldout.py:79 replaces run_differs with a stub `def run_differs(ctx)`, so the real gate never executes
ABSENCE: `search_files tests skip_invariant_filing` -> (no matches); recover_pending_bindings hits reference only the legacy filter path (test_reconcile_filter)
dropped.finding: The new canonical-selection side-effect suppression in run_differs.py (`scoped_ids = ctx.filter_local_ids or ctx.selection_ids`, gating invariant bug-filing and recover_pending_bindings) has no test. The pre-differ scope test mocks run_differs out entirely, and test_reconcile_filter covers only the legacy filter_local_ids path — so a regression where a canonical --only/--except pass fails to suppress whole-store invariant CREATE filing or pending-binding recovery (a scope-leak the ADR requires closed) would not be caught.
